name: c64-resurrect
description: Repair OCR misreads in scanned 1984 Commodore 64 type-in listings on a real C64 emulator, through a checksum gate that refuses any edit the magazine's own printed :rem checksum does not allow. Packages the repo's c64 MCP server (6 tools), the petscii-notation skill and the BASIC V2 error guide.
